## When to apply
Before any file_edit call.

## Steps
1. Always file_read the target file first to see current content
2. Copy the exact text you plan to replace - character for character
3. Verify the text still exists at the expected location (files change)
4. Only then call file_edit with the verified old_text

## Why this matters
Stale assumptions about file content are the #1 cause of failed edits. Files may have been modified by previous steps, other tools, or concurrent processes.

## Pitfalls
- Assuming file content from memory without re-reading
- Using approximate text that differs in whitespace or punctuation
- Editing a file that was already modified by an earlier step in the same task
